name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Sumner WA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open multi-tenant distribution building (the Cascade Building, Sumner Corporate Park). North dock court fronts 24th St E directly via open curb cuts with only a landscape strip; no barrier, fence, or checkpoint. South court connects to the open park road network. Confirmed in z19 satellite and Mar-2025 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any court entrance.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with two distinct dock banks on opposite (north and south) faces, both holding backed-in trailers.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: North dock doors face directly onto 24th St E across only a narrow landscape strip; trucks back in from the street-side apron with minimal stacking depth, so a queue would spill toward the road.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Shallow street-side dock apron on the north face; only 1-2 trucks of approach depth before docking.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Drop trailers (no tractors) parked along the building's west side and within the dock courts.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~70 doors combined across the north and south faces of the Cascade Building (band 50+); multi-tenant building (Mobis occupies ~181,000 of 385,468 SF) so Mobis-allocated share uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop trailers along the west strip and courts; estimate 10-25 band.
